ns2:course.label: Graduate Conducting Forum
ns2:course.description: Lectures, readings, interdisciplinary experiences, and group discussion regarding conducting techniques, ensemble psychology, ensemble administration, and other subjects within the professional domain of ensemble conductors. May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: Admission into the graduate conducting programs (MM and DMA) in choral, band, or orchestra; consent of instructor.
